carrier_boss.transfer_note: Full 7.2 mm straight seat. This intentionally differs from the original OD30 boss with a 0.6 mm lead-in. Copy this section before transferring its fit.

carrier_keeper.transfer_note: Flat outer-race keeper; actual race, spacer, bolt and washer clearances require assembly fit.

face_carrier.transfer_note: The 0.6 mm inner ligament is reproduced for a fit trial, not approved for torque. No gear teeth or torque capacity are represented.

thermal_design.status: Unvalidated thermal design estimate; no CFD, flow test or temperature test performed.
thermal_design.required_frame_clearance: Positive-side rails must taper from x15..21 to x9..14.4 by u110 to fit the lower cover. The y35.5..48 fin bank occupies x+/-14, u24..103.

hardware_to_integrate.note: Fastener solids belong to the caller assembly. Select actual lengths after the frame and cover mounting interfaces are fixed. Four 5.8 mm access counterbores pass through the fin bank at x+/-6, u35 and u70.

ventilation.direction: Rear-facing lower intake and upper exhaust; buoyancy depends on leg pose.
ventilation.method: Rectangular geometric free areas. The series bound covers the two baffled vent groups; the fin-bank channel cross-sections are listed separately. Side bypasses, entrance losses, fouling and pressure drop are unmodelled.

thermal_design.heat_path: Motor case -> split aluminium clamp -> bolted aluminium spine -> exposed fin channels -> baffled vents.
thermal_design.area_method: Both broad fin faces after five tip reliefs, with a conservative full-diameter rectangle deducted for each screw-head access bore crossing each fin face, plus the tapered rail-root pockets. Spine and fin-edge areas are omitted; this is an arithmetic area estimate.
thermal_design.total_heat_note: 5..7 W includes an unmeasured allowance for other motor/gearbox losses; I^2R alone is 2.18 W at 1 A.
thermal_design.sensitivity_note: h=3,5,8 W/m^2/K are assumed sensitivity cases, not measured coefficients. Contact resistance adds rise.

conditional_limits.note: These are proposed controller limits, not validated material or motor ratings. Fit case and shell sensors and verify winding temperature before sustained operation. The duty estimate omits contact resistance and requires a steady averaged heat model; a stalled motor cannot be approved by averaging duty. Reduce current/duty or add airflow if measured temperatures approach the limits.
